fix: Linux Docker deployment (Block 19): a server on an SSH host can run as a container instead of a process. One container per instance from a runtime image CONTROL builds on the host (fixed Dockerfile on stdin, base pinned by digest); base game and core mounted read-only, the instance home as the only writable bind mount; read-only root, no capabilities, no new privileges, never restarted by Docker; identity by container ID, name and labels. Docker through the docker group needs a typed confirmation per host. A stopped instance can be switched between native and docker. RCON and monitoring work unchanged through the port published on 127.0.0.1 of the host.
notes: 4.18.25 source preflight with the Docker deployment gate (scripts/verify-4.18.25-docker-gate.mjs: scripted docker and, where a daemon answers, real Docker with a stand-in core). The native Docker check (scripts/verify-4.18.25-docker-native.mjs) ran in the cloud container against a local sshd and Docker 29 with a stand-in core, not with a real CoD4x core and base game. Development source, not a release.
